subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `${VAR}`/`$VAR` placeholders inside shared user path resolution for skill and workspace install targets, or keep env substitution limited to config loading and repair/document the install path instead?
rationale: The bug is clear, but the fix changes a shared path contract that can affect config paths, workspace selection, and install destinations beyond this report.

options.title: Adopt narrow path expansion
options.body: Expand env placeholders in the shared path helper with focused tests for skill install/workspace paths and explicit unknown-var behavior.

options.title: Keep config-only substitution
options.body: Leave raw path helpers literal, add doctor/docs warnings for placeholder paths, and direct users to supported config env substitution and `openclaw skills install`.

options.title: Defer to broader dotenv work
options.body: Track this as part of the open dotenv/reference expansion discussion before changing path behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt narrow path expansion
recommendation.body: Expand env placeholders in the shared path helper with focused tests for skill install/workspace paths and explicit unknown-var behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both the shared path helper refactor and the native skill install CLI flow, so he has the strongest code-history signal for this boundary choice.
